findings.message: Hero headline is 36 words ("S S I I L L V V E E S S T T R R E E F F E E R R N N A A N N "). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Quem é Silvestre"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section.figures at 3202px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.
